title: CoherentFormalModuleAffineLimitEquivalence
statement: Let $X,I,V,A,J$ be as follows: $X$ is Noetherian, $I$ is a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, $V$ is an affine open with Noetherian open subscheme, $A=\Gamma(X,V)$ and $J=I(V)$. For coherent formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] and completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], there is an equivalence $E:\mathit{Coh}(V,I|_V)\simeq\mathrm{Fin}(\widehat A)$ and, for each local formal module $F$, an $A$-linear limiting cone whose point is the underlying restricted $A$-module of $E(F)$ and whose diagram is the top-section system of $F$, with scalars transported along $V.\mathrm{topIso}^{-1}$. For every $f:F\to G$ and level $n$, its projections satisfy $\mathrm{Res}(E(f))p_{G,n}=p_{F,n}\Gamma(f_n)$.

source.place: Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine restriction; official tag pages read during this delivery

proof.text: Obtain the affine Spec transport equivalence T with diagram comparison d. Apply coherentFormalModules_affine to A, J and the canonical ofIdealTop sheaf; its ideal equality is reflexive. Compose the equivalences T and E.

For each local F postcompose the supplied Spec cone with (d.app F).inv. IsLimit.postcomposeInvEquiv transports its universal property. The supplied projection naturality followed by the component of d.inv.naturality proves the local projection naturality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_affine_limit_equivalence
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    [IsNoetherian V.1.toScheme] :
    ∃ E : CoherentFormalModule V.1.toScheme (I.comap V.1.ι) ≌
      ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
        (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion (I.ideal V) Γ(X, V.1)) ↦
          Module.Finite (AdicCompletion (I.ideal V) Γ(X, V.1)) N),
    ∃ p : ∀ F : CoherentFormalModule V.1.toScheme (I.comap V.1.ι),
      (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (AdicCompletion (I.ideal V) Γ(X, V.1)))).obj
            (E.functor.obj F).obj) ⟶
      F.obj ⋙ (SheafOfModules.evaluation V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars V.1.topIso.inv.hom),
    (∀ F, Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ (p F)))) ∧
    (∀ (F G : CoherentFormalModule V.1.toScheme (I.comap V.1.ι))
      (f : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ),
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (AdicCompletion (I.ideal V) Γ(X, V.1)))).map
          (E.functor.map f).hom ≫ (p G).app (op n) =
      (p F).app (op n) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars V.1.topIso.inv.hom).map (f.hom.app (op n)))
